label: For "Vendor Access Risk Prediction": Identify unusual vendor access patterns, such as unexpected location, time or frequency and policy deviations, so security staff can review with explainable context and no automatic accusation. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on investigated cases only.
